title: Manadhil Ninraval
desc: Aditya, an outgoing young man, falls in love with Varsha, an introvert. Varsha has feelings for him but is reluctant to profess them and they both part ways only to meet again after a few years.

title: Dharala Prabhu
desc: Prabhu agrees to become a sperm donor for a fertility clinic, leading to a significant change in his life.

title: Gentleman Sathya
desc: Sathyam and Chaitra meet unexpectedly and decide to only lie to each other. Soon, after they fall in love, Sathyam encounters Padmanabham, a criminal on the run from the Indian police.

title: M.C.A
desc: Nani saves his sister-in-law from a criminal in illegal business.

title: Vellai Pookal
desc: A 57-year-old retired officer in the Chennai crime branch goes to Seattle to reunite with his estranged son. However, a missing case in his son's neighbourhood prompts him to start an investigation.

title: Virata Parvam
desc: Vennela, inspired by Naxal leader Ravi, defies societal norms and her family to pursue him amidst political turmoil, only to discover his disinterest in love.

title: Idhu Dhanda Police
desc: Ramakrishnan, police constable turned driver at Elathur women's police station, must navigate the fiery sub-inspector, Arundhathi Varma, to retain his job.

title: Rowdy Raja
desc: A young man suffers from kleptomania, which causes a lot of problems in his love life as his lover's father despises thieves.

title: Kirik Party
desc: Karna joins college and makes friends. He meets Saanvi, a senior, and events challenge his beliefs. The story shows their college life with humor.

title: Kaadu Nelam
desc: Despite his education failing to secure a job, a shepherd's son embraces his family trade. Through shepherding, he rediscovers himself and finds his true calling.

title: Mister
desc: A charismatic bachelor lands a dream job but must prove himself when fate tests his mettle, relationships, and ability to see past charm in pursuit of real love and responsibility.

title: Malayappa
desc: The home minister asks Tirupathi to impersonate the late ACP Baldev, his lookalike, to capture gangster Ganguly. In his new role, Tirupathi uncovers startling revelations.

title: Manam
desc: Bittu, a young boy who lost his parents, encounters two college students who bear a striking resemblance to his deceased parents' younger selves decades later.

title: Action Hero Biju
desc: Action Hero Biju follows Sub Inspector Biju Paulose's daily life as a police officer in a Janamaithri Police Station, offering a realistic view of cop life beyond typical action movie stereotypes.

title: Pokkiri Paiyan
desc: A trouble-making youth in a small town resorts to conning locals. When innocence meets ambition, he discovers empathy, friendship, and the power of redemption in unexpected ways.

title: Ok Kanmani
desc: At a wedding, Adi and Tara decide to live together, defying marriage norms.

title: America To Aminjikarai-Swa
desc: Shailu, grumpy and overwhelmed, finds a hopeful friend in KK. But KK carries his own troubles, complicating their chance at a new beginning together.

title: Iruvarin Ulagam Ondre
desc: A man and a woman, who are born on the same day, fall in love with each other. However, due to unfortunate circumstances, they keep getting separated.

title: Poda Podi
desc: Arjun and Nisha happily marry as they are madly in love with each other. However, trouble brews in their lives when they realize that they have to make a lot of sacrifices to make their marriage work.
